title: What they said at the time

clips.q: EToys can take its place in the pantheon of core Internet stocks, like an Amazon.com or an EBay.
clips.who: **Gail Bronson**, IPO Monitor, in the Los Angeles Times, May 21, 1999[^4]

clips.q: We are disappointed that sales have not materialized to the degree we had expected.
clips.who: **Toby Lenk**, president and chief executive, Dec 15, 2000[^5]

clips.q: Their TV advertising alone made eToys a household name, even though the households didn’t necessarily have Internet access. For KB to acquire that is a rip-off.
clips.who: **Chris Byrne**, toy analyst, in Wired, May 17, 2001[^11]
